headlines.description: New Germany manager Jürgen Klopp got his first win with a 2-0 Nations League victory over Serbia in Munich on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wirtz scores as Klopp gets first win with Germany

headlines.description: Wales ended their long wait for a Nations League A win by beating Norway 2-1 in Cardiff.
